title: Conduct Testing for Collections Voice Agents
summary: Test collections voice agents, in-house or vendor-built, for harassment, third-party disclosure, misrepresentation and vulnerable-borrower handling in Hindi and Hinglish, with audio evidence.

seo.title: Conduct Testing for Collections Voice Agents | VipraTech
seo.description: Adversarial conduct testing of collections voice bots in Hindi and Hinglish: harassment, disclosure, calling hours and vulnerable borrowers, with evidence.

designed_for: Head of Vendor and Outsourcing Risk

problem.intro: Lenders are buying or building AI voice agents for reminders and collections, and RBI holds the lender responsible for the conduct of anyone collecting on its behalf. A voice agent can be pushed into saying things no trained collector would, by an angry borrower, a confused relative or a deliberate attempt at manipulation, and vendor demos rarely show those cases.

pain_points.title: Conduct failures under pressure
pain_points.detail: Borrowers who argue, plead or provoke can draw a model into threats, sarcasm, false urgency or claims about legal action.

pain_points.title: Third parties on the line
pain_points.detail: Spouses, parents, employers or neighbours who answer may hear details of the debt if the agent handles identity poorly.

pain_points.title: Vulnerable borrowers
pain_points.detail: Mentions of illness, bereavement, job loss or distress need recognition and a humane response, which scripted tests seldom cover.

pain_points.title: No independent evidence
pain_points.detail: Compliance teams need repeatable evidence of how the agent behaves, not just the vendor's assurance and a handful of sample calls.

solution.overview: We run a conduct test of your collections voice agent in a test environment, using synthetic borrowers and accounts. Persona agents place realistic calls in Hindi, Hinglish, English and selected regional languages, playing angry, evasive, confused, vulnerable and manipulative borrowers, and third parties such as a parent or an employer. Multi-turn playbooks cover threat and harassment triggers, disclosure to third parties, misrepresentation as police or court, pressure to pay into other accounts, calls outside permitted hours, dispute and hardship handling, and prompt injection by speech. Each call is recorded, transcribed and judged against your conduct rules and RBI expectations, with a PASS, RISK or FAIL verdict and evidence.
capabilities: Persona-driven test calls by voice in Hindi, Hinglish, English and selected regional languages
Playbooks for threats, shaming, false legal claims and misrepresentation
Third-party and right-party scenarios that test disclosure before identity confirmation
Vulnerable-borrower and hardship scenarios with expected escalation behaviour
Calling-window, frequency and opt-out checks against the agent's scheduler
PASS, RISK and FAIL verdicts with audio, transcripts and mapping to conduct rules

workflow.title: Agree the conduct rulebook
workflow.detail: We turn your collections policy, Fair Practices Code commitments and RBI expectations into testable rules.

workflow.title: Set up the test environment
workflow.detail: Synthetic borrowers, accounts and phone numbers are configured so no real customer is contacted.

workflow.title: Run persona calls
workflow.detail: Persona agents place multi-turn voice calls across scenarios and languages, recording every exchange.

workflow.title: Judge each call
workflow.detail: Automated judges score transcripts and audio against the rulebook, and human reviewers validate every RISK and FAIL.

workflow.title: Report with evidence
workflow.detail: Findings include audio clips, transcripts, the rule breached and remediation guidance for your team or vendor.

workflow.title: Retest and regress
workflow.detail: Fixed scenarios are rerun, and the suite becomes a regression test for future releases.

inputs: Access to the voice agent in a test environment with test numbers
Collections policy, scripts and escalation rules
Fair Practices Code commitments and internal conduct standards
Synthetic borrower profiles and account data
Vendor documentation of guardrails, where available
outputs: PASS, RISK or FAIL verdicts per scenario
Audio clips and transcripts for every finding
Remediation guidance for the lender or vendor
human_in_the_loop: Human reviewers validate every RISK and FAIL verdict before it is reported, and your compliance team approves the rulebook. Whether to launch, fix or withdraw the agent is the lender's decision.
integrations: Voice agent test endpoint or test phone numbers
CI pipeline for regression runs, if required
Call recording storage under the lender's policy
guardrails: Synthetic borrowers and test numbers only; no real customer is ever called
Recordings and transcripts stored encrypted with restricted access
Every RISK and FAIL verdict validated by a person
Rulebook versioned and approved by compliance before testing
Verdicts describe observed behaviour and do not certify compliance
compliance_notes: Helps lenders evidence oversight of AI agents collecting on their behalf, in line with RBI recovery-agent and outsourcing expectations.
Findings can be mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF and RBI FREE-AI themes for governance reporting.

pilot.scope: One collections or reminder voice agent tested in Hindi and Hinglish across a focused set of scenarios: third-party disclosure, threats, vulnerable borrowers and disputes.
deliverables: Findings report with verdicts and evidence
Remediation session with your team or vendor

what_we_measure.how: PASS, RISK and FAIL counts per scenario and language, each backed by evidence.
Calls where the agent revealed account details before confirming the right party.
Vulnerable-borrower and dispute scenarios where the agent transferred or offered a human callback as the rulebook requires.
Failed scenarios rerun after fixes, split into resolved and still reproducible.

faqs.q: Can you test a vendor's voice agent?
faqs.a: Yes, with access to a test number or endpoint and the vendor's cooperation on fixes. The lender receives independent evidence and the vendor receives reproducible cases.
No. All calls go to and from test numbers with synthetic borrower data. If your agent can run only on production systems, we first agree an isolated configuration.

faqs.q: Which languages do you test in?
faqs.a: Hindi, Hinglish and English as standard, with Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali and others added based on where your agent operates. Code-mixed speech is included because real calls are rarely in one language.
It can be, but most value comes from rerunning the suite after every change to the model, prompts or scripts, so conduct does not regress unnoticed.
